name: shadcn/ui
description: Copy-and-own React components with a registry and CLI for adding source code to a project.
attribution: Preserve the MIT copyright and license notice in redistributed code.
scraping_api: Use the repository or documented registry; do not scrape the docs site.
acquisition: Pin a Git commit or use the documented shadcn registry commands.
limitations: Registry dependencies may have their own licenses.
Website examples and copy are not automatically reusable.
notes: Preferred starting point for reusable code, not screenshots.

name: Radix Primitives
description: Accessible, low-level React primitives for building custom interfaces.
attribution: Preserve the MIT notice.
scraping_api: Use package or repository distribution; do not scrape examples.
acquisition: Install the needed package or pin a repository commit.
limitations: Visual styling remains your responsibility.
Inspect any non-code asset separately.
notes: Strong accessibility foundation for original visual systems.

name: React Aria Components
description: Accessible, unstyled component APIs and hooks from Adobe's React Spectrum project.
attribution: Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and file-level notices.
scraping_api: Use the repository/package distribution; do not scrape Adobe product visuals.
acquisition: Install the required package and pin its version.
limitations: Spectrum visual assets and trademarks require separate review.
notes: Use for behavior and accessibility, then apply an original design system.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: Utility-first CSS framework and design token-friendly styling foundation.
attribution: Preserve the MIT notice when redistributing the framework code.
scraping_api: Use npm or GitHub distribution; docs content is not a component asset license.
acquisition: Install a pinned package version.
limitations: Utility classes do not themselves license third-party examples or assets.
notes: Good base for original layouts and normalized tokens.

name: Base UI
description: Unstyled accessible React components intended to be composed into original interfaces.
attribution: Preserve the MIT notice.
scraping_api: Use the official package/repository; do not scrape site examples.
acquisition: Install the package and pin its version.
limitations: Do not confuse base-ui.com with unrelated similarly named projects.
notes: Useful when the corpus needs behavior without prescribing a visual style.

name: MUI Core
license: MIT for MUI Core; paid license for MUI X Pro/Premium/Enterprise
description: Mature React component system with Material UI, Joy UI, Base UI, and system utilities.
commercial_public_use: yes for Core; conditional for paid X packages
attribution: Preserve MIT notices; review paid package EULAs.
scraping_api: Use packages and repositories; do not scrape Pro demos.
acquisition: Install Core packages at pinned versions.
limitations: Do not copy paid Pro/Premium blocks into a public corpus without the correct license.
Avoid implying Material Design or Google affiliation.
notes: Split Core and paid X records in any downstream manifest.

name: Flowbite Free
license: MIT for released free code; CC BY 3.0 for documentation code; Pro uses a separate EULA
description: Tailwind components and sections with a useful free tier and stricter Pro boundaries.
commercial_public_use: yes for free code; conditional for Pro
modification: yes for free code; restricted for Pro redistribution
attribution: Check the applicable free-code, CC BY, or Pro requirement.
scraping_api: Use documented downloads and repositories; do not scrape Pro pages.
acquisition: Acquire only free source files or a licensed Pro seat.
limitations: Do not publish a public repository of Pro elements.
Do not redistribute downloaded Pro files or build a competing template service.
notes: B is deliberate because the product mixes multiple license scopes.

name: HyperUI
description: Copy-and-paste Tailwind components and sections with no runtime package dependency.
attribution: Preserve the MIT notice.
scraping_api: Use the repository; do not scrape site presentation or copy.
acquisition: Pin a repository commit and copy only needed code.
limitations: The site’s visual presentation and copy should not be treated as a separate asset license.
notes: Excellent source for layout patterns when the code license is preserved.

name: Carbon Design System
description: Open-source IBM design system with components, themes, tokens, motion guidance, and type foundations.
attribution: Preserve Apache notices and review embedded fonts/assets separately.
scraping_api: Use repositories and package distribution; do not scrape IBM product screens.
acquisition: Pin the code/design-kit repository and record file-level licenses.
limitations: Do not imply IBM affiliation.
Design kits can contain assets with different treatment.
notes: Strong token and enterprise UI reference.

name: Primer
description: GitHub’s open design system code and primitives for CSS, tokens, and branded components.
attribution: Preserve MIT notices and separate trademark/icon licenses.
scraping_api: Use repositories; do not scrape GitHub product screens or brand assets.
acquisition: Pin the needed repository and record package-level notices.
limitations: GitHub marks and product visuals are not licensed by the CSS repository alone.
notes: Use code/tokens as A; keep branded visual references separate.

name: Style Dictionary
description: Transforms normalized design tokens into platform-specific outputs.
attribution: Preserve Apache notices.
scraping_api: Not an extraction permission; only process owned or authorized inputs.
acquisition: Install a pinned package version.
limitations: It does not grant rights to tokens extracted from third-party websites.
notes: Use after legal review and normalization, not as a crawler.

name: Google Fonts
license: Family-specific; commonly OFL-1.1, Apache-2.0, or Ubuntu Font License
description: Large font catalog suitable for a local font index when each family’s license is recorded.
commercial_public_use: usually yes, subject to family license
modification: usually yes under OFL, subject to Reserved Font Names
attribution: Preserve each family’s license and notices.
scraping_api: Use documented API or repository; do not bulk-mirror blindly.
acquisition: Pin a family/version and save its license file beside the font.
limitations: No single Google Fonts license covers every family.
Reserved Font Names can restrict modified distribution.
notes: B keeps the family-level license gate visible.

name: Heroicons
description: MIT-licensed SVG icon set with React and Vue packages.
attribution: Preserve MIT notices.
scraping_api: Use the repository or package; do not collect unrelated brand marks.
acquisition: Pin the package/repository version.
limitations: Brand logos are not automatically covered by a generic icon-set license.
notes: Safe default icon source for the corpus.

name: Open Peeps
description: Hand-drawn people illustration library released for broad reuse under CC0.
attribution: Not required by CC0; keep source metadata for provenance.
scraping_api: Use the official download flow; do not misrepresent third-party marks as CC0.
acquisition: Download permitted source files and retain source URL.
limitations: Privacy, publicity, and trademark rights can still apply to embedded real-world marks.
notes: Good first illustration source because the reuse grant is explicit.

name: Motion
description: Animation runtime and examples for React, JavaScript, and Vue.
attribution: Preserve the MIT notice.
scraping_api: Use runtime packages and repository examples; do not scrape showcase content.
acquisition: Install a pinned package version.
limitations: Example media or third-party assets need their own review.
notes: Use for behavior; keep motion subtle and accessible.

name: Openverse
license: Per-asset license; Openverse does not own or guarantee every asset
description: Search and API index for openly licensed media, with responsibility remaining on the reuser.
attribution: Usually required by the original license.
scraping_api: Use the documented API; no catalog scraping, rate bypass, or mirror service.
acquisition: Record source URL, creator, license, and attribution before saving an asset.
limitations: Openverse does not independently grant the underlying asset license.
Do not store the full catalog.
notes: B is the correct default for every search result until manually verified.

name: Unsplash API
license: Unsplash License plus API guidelines and terms
description: Photo API with attribution, hotlinking, download-event, and rate-limit requirements.
modification: yes under license, subject to restrictions
attribution: Credit the photographer and Unsplash as required by the API guidelines.
scraping_api: Use only the documented API; trigger download_location and respect quotas.
acquisition: Use API URLs and record creator/profile/source metadata.
limitations: Do not sell unmodified images or build a competing image service.
Keep API keys private.
notes: Do not bulk-download into the corpus by default.

name: Stripe product design reference
description: Reference for product hierarchy, restrained color, and dashboard interaction patterns.
modification: do not modify or rehost brand assets
attribution: Identify Stripe as the source of the reference link; do not imply endorsement.
scraping_api: Do not scrape or mirror product screenshots.
acquisition: Save URL, date, and original design observations only.
limitations: Stripe marks, trade dress, screenshots, and copy remain protected.
notes: Reference-only by design.

name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
license: Guidance content; no general license to copy Apple visuals or assets
description: Reference for platform conventions, hierarchy, motion, and interaction clarity.
modification: do not modify or rehost Apple assets
attribution: Keep Apple attribution in internal notes when quoting guidance.
scraping_api: Do not scrape Apple pages or assets.
acquisition: Save URL, date, and original observations only.
limitations: Apple logos, screenshots, icons, and product imagery are restricted.
notes: Use for principles, not visual cloning.

name: Mobbin
description: Valuable manual inspiration source, but not an approved automated local corpus source.
attribution: Follow the service terms if manually linking.
scraping_api: Terms prohibit unauthorized scraping, archiving, rehosting, and AI indexing.
acquisition: Store only a source link and personal notes unless written permission says otherwise.
limitations: Do not create a screenshot mirror or content repository.
notes: Blocked from automated acquisition.

name: Dribbble
description: Manual visual reference only; automated copying or storage is not approved.
attribution: Follow Dribbble and creator terms for manual links.
scraping_api: Terms prohibit scraping, copying, saving, storing, and competing services.
acquisition: Save URL and own notes only.
limitations: Do not download shots or build a local screenshot repository.
notes: Blocked from automated acquisition.

name: Behance
description: Manual portfolio reference only; Adobe terms do not approve general extraction or mining.
attribution: Follow Adobe and creator terms for manual links.
scraping_api: Adobe terms prohibit data mining and similar extraction; API rules add storage limits.
acquisition: Save URL and own notes only.
limitations: Do not create a local copy of project media or screenshots.
notes: Blocked from automated acquisition.

name: Refero
license: Proprietary service content; no general local-repository license found
description: Screen and flow reference service; use the official website or MCP as a research interface.
attribution: Keep Refero as the source of the link in internal notes.
scraping_api: Use official MCP under its plan terms; do not download or mirror the content corpus.
acquisition: Save URLs and personal analysis; request written permission for asset export.
limitations: Official MCP returns requested results server-side; it does not grant local rehosting rights.
notes: The community CLI was smoke-tested for listing only; pull/download remains intentionally disabled.

name: Lucide Icons
description: Open-source SVG icon library with framework packages and a broad general-purpose vocabulary.
attribution: Preserve the ISC notice; do not treat brand logos as generic icons.
scraping_api: Use the repository or package distribution; do not scrape unrelated showcase content.
acquisition: Pin the package or repository version and retain its license.
limitations: Third-party libraries bundled with a distribution can have their own licenses.
Brand marks need separate review.
notes: Added through the CLI write path as an end-to-end check.
